target.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users editing a Nostr profile could click **Import from Relays** and have relay data merged into their config before they reviewed it. The form stayed editable while the request was pending, so a same-field edit could be overwritten by the response. Cancel hid the form but did not stop the server-side merge, leaving the mutation persisted.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Nostr import route now returns relay data as a draft and never writes profile config. The Control UI explicitly requests the draft form, locks profile editing controls while the import is pending, passes a caller-owned `AbortSignal`, and aborts and invalidates the operation when Cancel, disconnect, or replacement occurs. The old unused server merge helper and its tests were removed.

## User Impact

Import only fills the form after the relay request completes. Users can review and edit the imported profile, then explicitly choose **Save & Publish**. Cancel no longer hides a config mutation that was already persisted, and stale import responses cannot replace a newer form.

## Evidence

- Regression coverage added in `extensions/nostr/src/nostr-profile-http.test.ts`, `ui/src/pages/channels/channels-page.test.ts`, and `ui/src/pages/channels/view.test.ts`.
- Control UI Playwright coverage added in `ui/src/e2e/nostr-profile-import.e2e.test.ts` for the request body, disabled fields, and Cancel flow.
- `corepack pnpm dlx --silent oxfmt --check --threads=1` on all nine changed files — passed.
- `git diff origin/main --check` — passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main` — clean; no accepted/actionable findings.
- The focused Vitest/Playwright command was attempted but could not start because this worktree has no `node_modules`; the wrapper reported `OPENCLAW_MISSING_VITEST` before collecting tests.
- Remote proof was attempted but unavailable: Blacksmith Testbox reported `not authenticated — run 'blacksmith auth login' first`; brokered AWS Crabbox reported that `crabbox login --url https://crabbox.openclaw.ai --provider aws` is required.

## Limitations

The focused tests and Control UI browser run still need executable proof in PR CI or an authenticated Testbox/Crabbox environment. No live Nostr relay was used; relay import behavior remains covered through the existing deterministic test seam.
